協会けんぽ (Japan Health Insurance Association) · 厚生労働省 (MHLW) · FY2026

Frequently asked questions

Why is there a new small deduction on my pay slip since May 2026?

It is the child and childcare support levy (子ども・子育て支援金). It started in April 2026 and is usually taken from May pay. The rate is 0.23% of your standard monthly pay in total, shared between you and your company, so your part is small.

My friend earns the same, but pays a different amount of health insurance. Why?

Health insurance rates are different in each prefecture. With Kyokai Kenpo, for example, Tokyo is 9.85% in FY2026 (shared with your company). Company health insurance societies set their own rates. If you are 40 to 64, long-term care insurance (1.62%) is also added. Also, the amount is based on your pay grade (標準報酬月額), not your exact pay.

How much is employment insurance?

For most jobs, you pay 0.5% (5 per 1,000) of your total pay, including overtime and commuting allowance, from April 2026 to March 2027. Before April 2026 it was 0.55%. Some industries use a different rate.

Will income tax on my pay change in 2027?

The National Tax Agency has published new withholding tax tables for pay received in 2027. The amounts change because the basic deduction (基礎控除) was raised in the 2026 tax reform. Your company uses the new table automatically. How much your tax changes depends on your pay and family situation.
